title: Slice report (mship)
description: The structured result mship returns for one slice of a plan: what the slice delivered, whether its acceptance was actually demonstrated, and what the loop decided to do next. Aggregated into the run report under context/project/out/<plan-id>/. Like every other report schema it is shape-only: which outcome was correct is judgment, and nothing here checks it.

slice.description: The slice this report covers, matching the plan graph's slices[].slice. 00 is the walking skeleton.

outcome.description: mship's decision at this slice boundary: continue to the next slice, ask the developer to judge something no command can settle, re-cut the slices still outstanding, run an mspec cascade that changes a shared agreement, or stop.

acceptance.description: Whether the slice's behaviour was demonstrated. unconfirmed is the --gate never case — acceptance that could only be judged by a person, run with nobody to ask — and is deliberately neither pass nor fail, so a report cannot present an unlooked-at slice as demonstrated.

reason.description: Why the loop decided what it did. Required when outcome is stop, replan or cascade, since each is a decision that must say why.

stories_applied.description: The stories of this slice that merged green.

spec_defects.description: Every spec_defect this slice's story agents reported, relayed from their story reports. What re-planning is decided against.

question.description: What the developer is being asked to judge. Present only when outcome is ask.

artifacts.description: What the developer was asked to look at.

kind.description: The same closed, narrow enum story-report.schema.json carries: contradicts-contract = spec and a contract it must honour cannot both be satisfied; inexpressible = the spec describes something the code cannot be made to do.

telemetry.description: Rough actuals for the slice (never a pre-run estimate). Departure from what earlier slices cost is what stops a run.
